status_summary: On 2026-07-13 the President signed Proclamation 11043, cutting Bears Ears National Monument from about 1.36 million to about 121,000 acres, and Proclamation 11044, cutting Grand Staircase-Escalante from about 1.87 million to about 181,500 acres (both published 2026-07-17). Excluded lands became open to mining, mineral leasing and public land laws 60 days after signing (around 2026-09-11), subject to valid existing rights. Around 2026-09-02 conservation groups and Patagonia, joined by a nonprofit led by Ute Mountain Ute members, moved in federal district court in Washington to reopen the 2017 monument lawsuits and challenge the 2026 proclamations under the Antiquities Act. Reports differ on tribal filings: KUER said tribal nations were expected to file their own suits, while Backpacker described the Native American Rights Fund representing the Hopi, Zuni and Ute Mountain Ute tribes in the coalition. No injunction or ruling had been reported as of early September 2026, and one outlet expected the cases to stay in procedural stages into early 2027. The sources reviewed show no proclamation for the Maine or Oregon monuments the Mandate named and no proposal to repeal the Antiquities Act.

timeline.event: The President signs Proclamation 11043 modifying Bears Ears National Monument: reservation reduced from about 1.36 million acres to about 121,096 acres in two units; the Bears Ears Commission is terminated (published 2026-07-17).

The President signs Proclamation 11044 modifying Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument: reservation reduced from about 1.87 million acres to about 181,541 acres in two units (published 2026-07-17).

Conservation groups (represented by Earthjustice, NRDC and SUWA) and Patagonia, with a nonprofit led by Ute Mountain Ute members, move to reopen the 2017 monument lawsuits to challenge the 2026 Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante reductions; KUER reports tribal nations were expected to file their own suits; no injunction reported (exact filing date not shown in the sources).
